title: Beyond the 956: Anthony Clark, “Yes, Dear” star, dies at 62

content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Anthony Clark, the comedian and actor best known as Greg Warner on the CBS sitcom Yes, Dear, has died at 62.

Clark died Tuesday, November 10, 2026. His former Yes, Dear co-star Mike O’Malley announced the death Wednesday on social media, writing, “Anthony Clark died yesterday. He was a hilarious guy.” Deadline, Variety, The Hollywood Reporter and Entertainment Weekly confirmed the death. No cause of death has been disclosed.

Born April 4, 1964, in Lynchburg, Virginia, Clark graduated from Emerson College and got his start as a stand-up comic in Boston, where he was already selling out shows at The Comedy Connection in the 1990s.

Clark found lasting success on Yes, Dear, which ran on CBS for six seasons, from 2000 to 2006, for 122 episodes. He starred as Greg Warner alongside O’Malley, Jean Louisa Kelly and Liza Snyder in the comedy about two couples raising their families under one roof.

He also starred in the sitcoms Boston Common and Soul Man, and appeared in the film The Rock and on Ellen.

Rest in Peace, Anthony Clark.

Sources: Deadline; Variety; The Hollywood Reporter; Entertainment Weekly.
